paragraphs: From Drogheda Test Centre at Southgate Shopping, exit and take the 1st right onto Dublin Road.
After about 700m, turn left into Five Oaks.
Follow the road as it bends left into the estate.
Practice a turnabout in this quiet residential area.
Make your way back out of Five Oaks and turn left onto Dublin Road.
Take the next right into Wheaton Hall.
Turn left into Foxhill and follow it around to the right.
Practice observations and a reverse around the corner here.
Retrace your route back through Wheaton Hall and turn right onto Dublin Road.
Follow Dublin Road straight ahead as it becomes James Street, then John Street, then Rathmullan Road.
At the fork, keep slight right onto Bridge of Peace and continue onto George's Street.
Take the 1st right onto Windmill Road.
Take the next right onto Bóthar Brugha.
At the end of the road, turn left onto Hardman's Gardens.
Keep slight left at the fork.
At the roundabout, take the slight left exit to stay on Hardman's Gardens, which becomes Ballymakenny Road.
Turn right into Ascaill a hAon.
Turn left into Ascaill a Trí.
Take a slight left onto Flaxmill Lane and pull in to practice.
Rejoin Flaxmill Lane and turn right into Newfield to complete a turnabout.
Return to Flaxmill Lane and retrace via Ascaill a Trí and Ascaill a hAon back to Ballymakenny Road.
Turn left onto Ballymakenny Road.
At the roundabout, take the slight left exit onto Hardman's Gardens, which becomes Sunday's Gate and Scarlet Street.
Perform a turnabout onto Magdalene Street.
Continue straight through Saint Peter's Street and Shop Street.
Turn left onto James Street and follow Dublin Road for around 2.5km back toward the test centre.
Take a slight left, then at the roundabout go straight.
Exit left into Southgate Shopping to finish back at Drogheda Test Centre.
